newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Housewares buys two units for 15 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Housewares buys two units for 15 mln rand.

text.p: South Africa's Housewares Group Ltd said on Tuesday it had acquired Leading Concepts and Homeworths businesses for 15 million rand from Wooltru Group Ltd with effect from January 13, 1997.
The acquisition will be settled by the issue of Housewares shares to Wooltru at five rand per share, the company said.

"Benefits flowing from the transaction will contribute to future growth and underline Housewares' leadership position in its chosen markets," joint managing director Steve Hochstadter said in a statement.
Leading Concepts, founded six years ago, is a mail order business with an active database of 250,000 customers, and 12 retail outlets.
The unit will merge with Housewares' Glomail business which has nine outlets and help it to achieve critical mass and increase volumes, Housewares said.
Homeworths, a direct selling division founded 18 months ago, has a part-time salesforce of 2,000.

"The expertise that both Leading Concepts has in store retailing and that Homeworths has in part-time direct selling dovetails superbly with the core business of the Housewares group," Hochstadter said.
